newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Fifth Timorese held over attack on journalist.
newsitem.headline: Fifth Timorese held over attack on journalist.

text.p: A fifth East Timorese suspected of involvement in the beating of a journalist earlier this month has been arrested, the official Antara news agency reported on Wednesday.
"According to...witnesses, the journalist was only beaten by five people, all of whom have been detained," Colonel Yusuf Mucharam, East Timor's police chief, was quoted as saying.
Yusuf said the police still could not speculate on a motive for the attack.

Gaudensius Mau, a correspondent for the Jakarta-based Tiras magazine, said he was beaten on the evening of November 17 by eight youths who mistook him for an Indonesian intelligence officer. The attack put him in a hospital.

Many East Timorese resent the rule of Indonesia, which invaded the former Portugese colony in 1975 and annexed it as its 27th province the following year, a move still not recognised by the United Nations.
